Name: Quick Feet
Effect: While affected by a Status Ailment (Burn, Frostbite, Paralysis, Poison, Sleep), Increase this Pokémon's Dexterity Attribute by 2. If inflicted by Paralysis, this Ability prevents its effects.
Description: Most of the time this Pokémon will seem to be in a hurry. When pressured, it will move faster than normal.
